## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

- **api:** The orders endpoint now returns prices in cents instead of decimal currency units. Update any clients that read order prices. ([#214](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/214))

### Features

- **cart:** Carts are now saved for logged-out users for 30 days. ([#211](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/211))
- **ui:** Added dark mode to the account page. ([#217](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/217))

### Bug Fixes

- **checkout:** The total ignored the discount code on mobile. ([#213](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/213))
- **search:** The search box no longer loses focus after the first letter is typed. ([#215](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/215))
- **auth:** Password reset links now expire as intended. ([#219](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/219))

### Maintenance

- Bumped TypeScript to 5.9. ([#212](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/212))
- CI now caches `node_modules` between jobs. ([#216](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/216))
- Added a checkout regression test suite. ([#218](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/pull/218))

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### Added
- Download invoices as PDF (#301)
- Invite teammates by email (#304)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Removed the deprecated /v1/customers endpoint (#305)
- Search results load twice as fast on large catalogues (#308)

### Fixed
- VAT on invoice totals ending in .5 is now rounded correctly (#303)
- Date picker showed the wrong month in Safari (#307)

### Security
- Uploaded files can no longer be read by other accounts (#309)

## [0.9.2] - 2026-12-01

### Added
- New `tool doctor` command to check your setup (#42)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Config file renamed from `.toolrc` to `tool.toml` (#41)

### Fixed
- The `--quiet` flag no longer prints warnings (#40)
- Crash when using Windows paths that contain spaces (#45)

### Security
- Fixed a remote code execution vulnerability in the YAML parser (CVE-2026-4411) (#44)

## [3.2.0] - 2026-12-08

### Added
- Offline maps for saved trips (#515)
- Share a trip with a link that expires (#519)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Trips endpoint is paginated by default, returning 50 per page (#518)

### Fixed
- Edits made offline were lost after logging in (#517)
- Map pins overlapped on small screens (#521)

### Removed
- Legacy trip importer (#524)

### Security
- Shared links no longer expose the owner's email address (#522)

## [1.11.0] - 2027-01-05

### Added
- Spell check for 14 languages (#87)
- Export documents as Markdown (#91)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Internet Explorer 11 is no longer supported (#93)

### Fixed
- Undo skipping every second change (#89)
- Tables pasted from Excel losing their borders (#94)

### Security
- Session tokens no longer written to the browser console (#90)

## [4.0.1] - 2027-01-19

### Added
- Ability to pause a subscription for up to 3 months (#706)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Annual plans now renew on the purchase date instead of the 1st of the month (#702)

### Fixed
- Receipts showing the wrong currency symbol (#703)
- CSV export cutting off rows after 10,000 (#707)

### Security
- Webhook signatures are now verified, so forged webhooks are rejected (#705)
